summary: Post-close brief for 2026-10-27; the fact layer was generated at 2026-10-27T20:52:53Z (16:52 ET), after the US cash close, so both the US and the A-share readings are settled sessions. The composite is 58.4, downgraded from high_risk to caution, with the regime back to risk_on from late_cycle, a fall of 4.35 from 62.75 on 2026-10-26. The day's -2.52 is not a session-over-session move: it is measured against the 60.92 row written at 11:54Z the same day, so the index kept falling inside the calendar day. Price action was broad risk appetite: 20 of 22 sector and theme rows rose against 2 that fell, mean 2.4153 and median 2.8471, led by AI infrastructure 5.9478, quantum computing 5.5778 and networking 4.5529, with all 5 US names up and a 3.4337 mean. The fall in risk did not come from rates: the 10-year is still 5.0% and the real rate unchanged at 2.66, with rates and credit both on the 2026-10-26 observation, while macro 73.78 and liquidity_credit 72.12 together contribute 29.18 points, 49.97% of the 58.4 composite. The two legs that actually fell were VIX from 19.45 to 18.39 and HY OAS from 3.38 to 3.3, plus cross-asset confirmation from 0.625 to 0.5 as bitcoin turned positive and took bitcoin_down from triggered to untriggered. The gap is still in A-shares: the 11-name memory and packaging chain fell 3.2768% on average, 10 down and only 1 up, a second consecutive down session.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation at 0.5 is the single largest contribution at 7.5 points after a 0.8 proxy discount; 4 of the 8 production signals fire: dollar strength, real-rate pressure, small-cap underperformance and gold up. Bitcoin turned positive over 24 hours at 1.15467, taking bitcoin_down from triggered to untriggered, the only signal change this session.

Credit improved at the margin but has not entered safe territory: HY OAS tightened from 3.38 to 3.3 and contributes 6.46 points, with IG OAS at 0.9; the reverse repo balance of 0.226 still maps to a 96.79 risk score because the indicator is scored on absolute distance from its midpoint, so a thinner buffer scores higher risk.

The rates side did not ease: a 10-year nominal of 5.0% and a real rate of 2.66 are unchanged from the prior session, mapping to a macro dimension of 73.78; the real rate carries an in-dimension risk score of 98.24 and the 10-year nominal one of 96.47. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88 while FedWatch implies 4.045 for the 2026-12-16 meeting with a hike vector, so the rate path remains the only anchor for valuations.

Breadth is only half repaired: the share above the 200-day rose from 0.4065 to 0.4194, 65 of 155 names, and the new-low ratio fell from 0.141 to 0.0641. But the new-high ratio is still 0.0128, 2 new highs against 10 new lows on a 156-name sample, and the new-high indicator still carries a dimension risk score of 87.44.

The vintage itself is a risk: rates, credit and VIX all sit on the 2026-10-26 observation, 1 session behind the 2026-10-27 close; FX sits on 2026-10-23, 3 sessions behind rates; only the reverse repo carries a 2026-10-27 print. The rates and FX legs of the 58.4 reading do not reflect today's session.

supporting_signals.claim: The 4 remaining cross-asset triggers are structural and immune to one day of price action: the broad dollar index at 121.3202 sits above its 105 trigger and the real rate at 2.66 above the 1.5 trigger.

Small-cap weakness did not materially repair: on a 63-session basis IWM trails SPY by 8.4184 points with a dimension risk score of 71.84; the prior session was 8.8917, an improvement of only 0.4733 points.

Funding prices carry marginal pressure: SOFR at 3.93 sits above the effective fed funds rate of 3.88, a small but positive spread, while bank reserves have fallen from 3022140 to 2962607 on the Fed balance sheet basis for the 2026-10-21 observation, a thinner buffer.

The AI funding loop is the day's strongest narrative and its most fragile link: Nvidia and AMD taking a stake in Meta, and Broadcom arranging financial partners to buy AI racks built on custom accelerators, tie share prices directly to financing conditions. The Chinese source is a CLS item relayed through RSSHub, so second-hand aggregation rather than a first-party statement.

contradicting_signals.claim: The tape was very strong: 20 of 22 sector and theme rows rose, mean 2.4153 and median 2.8471; all 5 US names were up with a 3.4337 mean, led by AMD 5.4547, TSLA 4.0447 and AVGO 3.9979. The three major indices closed at Nasdaq 1.18, S&P 500 0.6 and Dow 0.03; the index closes come from CLS and Eastmoney items relayed through RSSHub, so second-hand aggregation.

The volatility dimension is only 34.3: VIX at 18.39 is below 20 and realized volatility of 9.9588 maps to a risk score of 10.0. Risk is not in fear pricing, and none of the composite comes from the volatility leg.
Credit does not confirm stress: HY OAS at 3.3 and IG OAS at 0.9 both sit low and both tightened against the prior print, with no sign of an imminent credit event.
The trend dimension is 43.41: the index sits just -1.2104 from its 52-week high and 5.7569 above its 200-day, with 3-month momentum at 5.5109. The price trend itself is not broken.
The leadership is the highest-beta bucket, not defensives: semis relative strength flipped from -3.233 in the prior session to 4.3945, taking its dimension risk score from 61.47 down to 48.41.

what_changed_today: The composite fell from 62.75 on 2026-10-26 to 58.4, a drop of 4.35; the level moved from high_risk back to caution and the regime from late_cycle back to risk_on.

The regime switch came from cross-asset confirmation falling from 0.625 to 0.5: late_cycle requires at least 0.55 and 0.5 no longer qualifies; the trigger count fell from 5 to 4, the only change being bitcoin turning positive at 1.15467. The cross_asset dimension fell from 62.5 to 50.0 and its contribution from 9.375 to 7.5.
VIX fell from 19.45 to 18.39, HY OAS tightened from 3.38 to 3.3 and IG OAS from 0.91 to 0.9; all three are 2026-10-26 observations, 1 session behind the close.

Breadth improved: the share above the 200-day rose from 0.4065 to 0.4194 and the new-low ratio fell from 0.141 to 0.0641, with the new-low count down from 22 to 10; the new-high ratio is unchanged at 0.0128, still 2 names.
The 22 sector and theme rows went from 17 up and 5 down to 20 up and 2 down, with the mean rising from 0.9784 to 2.4153 and the median from 1.2334 to 2.8471.

The 5 US names moved from a 3.1427 mean to 3.4337, still all higher; the 11 A-share names went from a -4.9382 mean with all 11 down to a -3.2768 mean with 10 down and 1 up, a smaller decline but the same direction.
Semis relative strength flipped from -3.233 to 4.3945, the largest structural move of the day; small-cap relative weakness improved only from 8.8917 to 8.4184.

After hours delivered a contrary reading: Seagate and NXP fell more than 7% and Western Digital more than 2%, while the memory theme had risen 4.135 during the session; the first after-hours prints in the memory chain are negative feedback, and the Chinese source is a CLS item relayed through RSSHub, so second-hand aggregation.
watch_next: The FOMC decision at 2026-10-28T18:00:00Z, early on 2026-10-29 Beijing time: holding at 3.88 is the baseline and the real variable is the statement and the communication. The so-called new Fed newswire reports a split among Fed leadership over the policy route and communication strategy, with Chair Warsh rejecting traditional forward guidance, which raises the information content of a single decision.

Earnings: MSFT and GOOGL on 2026-10-28, AMZN and INTC on 2026-10-29, AMD on 2026-11-03. AI capex and chip supply commentary lands directly in those calls, and the semiconductor equipment and data center rows are the most sensitive to it.

The first test for the memory chain: Seagate and NXP fell more than 7% after hours and Western Digital more than 2%, while the memory theme rose 4.135 during the session. If the 11 A-share names keep falling in the 2026-10-28 Asian session it is supply-chain repricing; a bounce would argue for a positioning event.

Whether the 10-year breaks below 5.0%: with the 5.0% nominal and the 2.66 real rate both unchanged, the 73.78 macro dimension has no room to fall, and this is the most direct channel back to high_risk.

The breadth thresholds: whether the share above the 200-day keeps climbing from 0.4194 and whether the 0.0128 new-high ratio lifts off the floor. Strong prices with a flat new-high count mean this is still a repair, not an expansion.

The AI funding loop: Nvidia and AMD taking a stake in Meta and Broadcom arranging financial partners to absorb AI racks is a structure that binds valuation to financing conditions. Any tightening in the chain shows up in the semiconductor equipment and data center rows first and reaches the composite later.

Vintages: rates, credit and VIX sit on 2026-10-26 and FX on 2026-10-23, so the macro and FX legs of the 58.4 reading do not yet reflect today's session; the 2026-10-28 refresh closes that gap, and until then the reading must not be described as reflecting today's rates.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the AI funding loop holds and breadth catches up to price
points: 20 of 22 rows rose and all 5 US names were up, led by AI infrastructure 5.9478 and networking 4.5529; if the funding chain behind Nvidia and AMD taking a stake in Meta keeps working, the 3.9099 semiconductor leadership has a fundamental leg.
If the 10-year breaks below 5.0%, the 73.78 macro dimension loosens first and the composite can settle below 60.
Breadth climbing from 0.4194 and the 0.0128 new-high ratio lifting are what would turn this move from a repair into an expansion.

base_case.title: Base case: caution chop between 57 and 62
points: The composite chops around 58.4: macro at 73.78 and liquidity_credit at 72.12 will not fall on their own, and a price rebound is unlikely to force them down.
The FOMC and the large-cap tech reports are absorbed, semis stay firm and breadth stalls near 0.4194.
The A-share and US divergence persists without spreading: the 11-name memory chain at a -3.2768 mean is in a second consecutive down session and has still not tripped any cross-asset signal.

bear_case.title: Bear case: a 5.0% 10-year plus negative after-hours feedback
points: A 10-year nominal of 5.0% and a 2.66 real rate are both unchanged, with FedWatch implying 4.045 for the 2026-12-16 meeting and a hike vector; a statement that hardens the path leaves the 73.78 macro dimension room to rise.

After hours already delivered negative feedback: Seagate and NXP fell more than 7% and Western Digital more than 2%, while the memory theme rose 4.135 during the session; if that feedback spreads to semiconductor equipment and data centers on 2026-10-28, the composite moves back above 60.
Small caps trail by 8.4184 points and the 0.0128 new-high ratio is 2 names out of a 156-name sample, so the conditions for breadth weakening ahead of price are already in place.
